record.original_question: Let (N, g) be an orientable closed hyperbolic surface. Is the Hofer-Zehnder capacity of the unit disk cotangent bundle (D^*N, d lambda) finite?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(N,g)$ be an orientable closed hyperbolic surface (a closed orientable smooth surface of genus $\geq 2$ equipped with a Riemannian metric of constant curvature $-1$). Let $T^*N$ denote its cotangent bundle, and let $\lambda$ be the canonical Liouville $1$-form on $T^*N$, so that $\omega = d\lambda$ is the standard symplectic form. Using the metric $g$, define the unit disk cotangent bundle
$$D^*N = \{(q,p)\in T^*N : \|p\|_g \leq 1\},$$
which is a compact symplectic manifold with boundary $(D^*N, d\lambda)$.

The Hofer–Zehnder capacity $c_{HZ}(M,\omega)$ of a symplectic manifold $(M,\omega)$ is defined as the supremum of $\max H - \min H$ over all smooth, compactly supported (in the interior) Hamiltonians $H:M\to\mathbb{R}$ that are constant near their maximum and minimum and whose Hamiltonian flow has no non-constant periodic orbit of period $\leq 1$.

Question: Is $c_{HZ}(D^*N, d\lambda) < \infty$?
artifact.status_search_result: Finiteness of the Hofer–Zehnder capacity of unit disk cotangent bundles is known for many closed manifolds (e.g., via loop product methods of Irie, and via local systems on the free loop space when the Hurewicz map $\pi_2(M)\to H_2(M;\mathbb{Z})$ is nonzero). Closed hyperbolic surfaces have $\pi_2=0$, so these criteria do not apply. Recent work (2024) on magnetic disc tangent bundles over constant-curvature surfaces explicitly notes that for hyperbolic surfaces even finiteness of the Hofer–Zehnder capacity remains unknown in the relevant (weak/zero magnetic field) regime, indicating the problem is still open.

status_evidence.title: Hofer–Zehnder capacity of magnetic disc tangent bundles over constant curvature surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: For hyperbolic surfaces even finiteness is unknown in the case of weak magnetic fields, though finiteness has been established for strong magnetic fields.
status_evidence.claim: Finiteness of Hofer–Zehnder capacity for hyperbolic surfaces in the unmagnetized/weak-field regime remains open.

status_evidence.title: Local systems on the free loop space and finiteness of the Hofer-Zehnder capacity
status_evidence.snippet: Finiteness of π1-sensitive Hofer–Zehnder capacity of unit disk bundles when the Hurewicz map π2(M)→H2(M;Z) is nonzero.
status_evidence.claim: Existing finiteness criteria via local systems do not cover closed hyperbolic surfaces (which have π2=0).

status_evidence.title: Hofer–Zehnder capacity of unit disk cotangent bundles and the loop product
status_evidence.snippet: Finiteness of Hofer–Zehnder capacity of unit disk cotangent bundles under topological conditions on the base.
status_evidence.claim: Loop-product method of Irie gives finiteness under conditions not satisfied by closed hyperbolic surfaces.
